description: Defines the ue_creation_procedure class and related structures for handling UE creation in a 5G DU environment, including interactions with MAC, F1, and RLC layers.

classes.name: ue_creation_procedure
classes.description: Handles the creation of a UE and its bearers in the DU environment, coordinating between MAC, F1, and RLC layers.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the UE creation procedure asynchronously.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the procedure, 'UE Create'.

methods.name: create_du_ue_context
methods.description: Creates a UE object in the DU UE manager.

methods.name: clear_ue
methods.description: Removes the UE from the DU UE repository.

methods.name: setup_du_ue_resources
methods.description: Sets up resources in the DU manager for the UE being created.

methods.name: create_f1ap_ue
methods.description: Creates a UE in the F1 interface.

methods.name: connect_layer_bearers
methods.description: Connects the layer bearers for the UE.
